en_US: The Battle Frontier’s as tough as they
say...
None of the facilities are cakewalks,
that’s for sure.
The best Trainers from around the
country...
No, the best Trainers from around
the world gather at the Battle Zone.
To toughen myself!
To toughen my Pokémon!
For that alone, I have come!
We’re doing a feature on tough Trainers
in the Battle Zone.
That’s where you come in.
We need you to battle us!
You don’t have to be shy.
We can obscure your face if we have to.
I go after interviews like my favorite
Pokémon move--I tackle them!
Of course, I don’t use Tackle in
battles, though.
Expert Trainer spotted!
Will you let us battle with you?
Great! Great!
You guys are great!
Want to see how good you are before
you go off to the Battle Frontier?
The combination of you and your Pokémon
will tear up the Battle Tower!
My GRENINJA and I came to take on
the Battle Frontier together.
But it keeps looking at you, as if
you two share some kind of bond...
Would you take it with you?
Fight side by side, and it’ll show
you power you’ve never seen.
{STRVAR_1 3, 0, 0} received the GRENINJA!
Would you like to give a nickname
to the GRENINJA you received?
Your party’s full. Come back when
you have room for it.
Oh... Well, it’ll be here
if you change your mind.
When GRENINJA knocks out a foe at
your side, its bond with you grows.
Then it takes on a whole new form!
